defects.title: RBAC config inconsistency: SALES_BD_REP holds product.view action but lacks product_management module grant
defects.evidence: In packages/contracts/src/auth.ts, SALES_BD_REP module list (line 334) omits product_management, yet the action list (line 360) includes 'product.view'. GET /product-management/families requires {module:product_management, action:product.view}; the module guard denies first with 403 'cannot access module product_management', so product.view is effectively unreachable for this role. Behavior fails closed (safe), but the dangling action grant is dead/contradictory config and contradicts the QA spec's 'rep can view families' expectation.
